name: extension-host core + desktop + workspace 1.0.1
comment: The signed application as shipped: desktop 1.0.0 and the action-only repair, workspace release/schema 1.0.1.
Its design differs from the retained 1.0.0 profile's (core-desktop-workspace-extension-host.json, held to the
retained bundle by `task compat:workspace-baseline-verify`) in the three appended action descriptions alone,
so its canonical digest differs on the same host and printer. The candidate versions are pinned here, apart
from the SDL and the digest, because an identical schema and digest cannot say which binary ran.
